headline: Executive order designates the drug fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction.
what_it_does: This executive order, based on its title, classifies fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and penalties involved are not described here. Such a label could change how the federal government treats fentanyl-related activity, but the details are not available from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: People involved in making or trafficking fentanyl
who_it_affects.how: Their activity may be treated by the federal government as involving a weapon of mass destruction, though the exact legal effects are not stated in the title.

who_it_affects.group: Federal law enforcement and national security agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may be directed to handle fentanyl under rules or authorities used for weapons of mass destruction.
